info.title: Jarvis-Forge per-test reports
info.description: Contract v1. Existing execution-step API is retained with its original meaning. New clients require this capability contract; no old-service adapter is provided. Pytest reports each actual collected item; command checks are final-only and counted separately. CTest/CI examples are fixtures, not implemented adapters.
